info.title: Daystar Christian Centre App API
info.description: API for DCC App REST endpoints

post.description:
Takes a set of user credentials and returns an access and refresh JSON web
token pair to prove the authentication of those credentials.

Takes a refresh type JSON web token and returns an access type JSON web
token if the refresh token is valid.

get.description: Returns the global approval interval in seconds.

patch.description: Updates the number of seconds before Area or Zone approval is allowed.

get.description: Returns pending reports the authenticated Section, Area, or Zone leader can review.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

get.description: Returns submission and approval totals for cells under the authenticated leader's scope. Use service_date for a Sunday; the latest Sunday is used when it is omitted.

parameters.name: service_date
parameters.description: Sunday to inspect in YYYY-MM-DD format.

get.description: Returns compliance for a region, district, zone, area, section, or cell. Leaders can only request their own level or descendants.

parameters.name: service_date
parameters.description: Sunday to inspect in YYYY-MM-DD format.

get.description: Returns pending reports the authenticated approver can act on, including submission time, waiting duration, and overdue status.
Downloads reports within an inclusive date range for the authenticated leader's scope. Dates must use YYYY-MM-DD format.

200.description: CSV file with cell report statuses.

get.description: Lists cells in the authenticated leader's scope that have not submitted for the selected Sunday. Use chronic=true to return cells missing three consecutive Sundays.

parameters.name: service_date
parameters.description: Sunday to inspect in YYYY-MM-DD format.

get.description: Returns one compliance summary for each Sunday in the selected period.

parameters.name: weeks
parameters.description: Number of Sundays to return: 4, 8, or 12.

get.description: Handle Cell Leader submissions and report approval actions.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

post.description: Creates one report for the authenticated Cell Leader's assigned cell. The service date must be a Sunday and the new report starts with PENDING approval status.

get.description: Handle Cell Leader submissions and report approval actions.

patch.description: Only the submitting Cell Leader can edit a report whose status is REJECTED.

post.description: Approves a pending report when the authenticated user is eligible to approve it.
Sends a pending report back for correction. An optional comment can explain the correction.

get.description: Returns reports submitted by the authenticated Cell Leader and their approval statuses.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

post.description: Creates one report for the authenticated Cell Leader's assigned cell using cell_code from the request body. The service date must be a Sunday and the new report starts with PENDING approval status.
post.summary: Submit a Sunday report via WhatsApp

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

post.description: Set the final user profile values and password using a valid magic link token.
Create an invite for a new leader and assign them to a hierarchy unit.
Authenticate a user with email and password and return a JWT access and refresh token pair.
Invalidate a refresh token to log the user out.
Send a password reset link to a registered user email if the account exists.
Reset the user's password using the token and UID sent in the reset email.
Exchange a valid refresh token for a new access token.
